title: soft-eviction-backoff-and-pool-replenish-playbook-for-small-tenant-starvation
creator: Maya Chen
description: Customer reported repeated 503s and degraded throughput for a group of small tenants during a weekday mid-afternoon spike. Root cause appears to be aggressive eviction of low-priority tenant slots combined with a mis-tuned replenishment signal that delayed reserved-pool refills by several minutes, causing a cascade of cold starts and burst-limit exhaustion.
reproduction_steps: 1) Start a synthetic traffic generator targeting 200 small-tenant connections with bursty 1-2s requests
2) Configure autoscaler with conservative warmup window (existing prod config) and enable eviction policy with priority dampening
3) Simulate a cluster-wide transient GPU preemption for 40s to trigger slot evictions
4) Observe reserved-pool headroom metric and tenant coldstarts; verify burst credits per-tenant drop to zero and requests receive 503/fallback responses
investigation_summary: Telemetry shows three converging failures: (A) eviction controller issued soft-evictions without exponential backoff causing many small tenants to be cycled; (B) replenisher used a moving-average horizon that ignored short spikes and therefore delayed scale-ups; (C) fairshare ledger reconciler did not account for recently returned slots leading to underestimation of available headroom. Combination produced a 'credit cliff' where tenants exhausted burst allowance before autoscaler recovered.
mitigations_applied: Deployed emergency config: increased soft-eviction backoff from 30s to 180s
Lowered min-warmup threshold for small tenant class so returned slots are eligible faster
Temp increased reserved-pool emergency buffer by 20% for affected region
hotfix_pr: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321 - implement eviction backoff + replenisher window tweak
deployment_rollout: Canary to us-east-1 (20% traffic) -> observe 1 hour -> region-wide rollout within 3 hours if stable. Rollback flag: autoscaler.eviction.backoff_seconds
follow_up_actions: Add unit/integration tests for eviction backoff logic
Rework replenisher to use hybrid short+long horizon signals (prototype in design doc)
Create customer-grade runbook for mini-burst starvation including automatic emergency buffer activation
Audit fairshare ledger reconciliation to ensure returned slots are visible within 10s
